name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Growth Marketer | Demand Gen, Email Programs & Customer Marketing
summary: Growth marketer and full-stack operator with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, agency, and revenue operations, building demand gen and lifecycle programs from nothing rather than optimizing what already runs. Founder of Solenzo, where a complete email and automation engine - 20+ workflows across capture, qualification, nurture, reactivation, and segmented cold outreach - was designed, built, and shipped solo. Spent a decade owning customer relationships and expansion before moving to the marketing side, so customer marketing, CS partnership, and sales enablement are familiar ground rather than new territory.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Built segmented cold-email lead gen engines from scratch - website-visibility, missed-call, and low-review campaigns - plus an automated prospect audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts by scoring each business's digital footprint.

Architected a complete marketing-automation system of 20+ workflows spanning lead capture, tagging and routing, qualification, appointment booking, no-show recovery, post-sale onboarding nurture, long-term reactivation, and automated review generation.
Design and deploy lifecycle sequences, onboarding workflows, and segmentation that activate, nurture, and retain users at scale in GoHighLevel and HubSpot.
Identify expansion opportunities inside the existing client base, scoping and recommending complementary services aligned to client objectives.
Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for B2B audiences.
Draft direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages, building reusable on-brand asset templates adapted per client rather than starting from scratch each time.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, reporting to business-owner stakeholders on a regular cadence.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated demand gen strategy across inbound, paid media, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments as strategic lead.
Produced high-converting campaign assets - landing pages, complex multi-touch email sequences, and conversion-focused copy - improving lead generation and pipeline.
Built campaign reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and quarterly business reviews.
Translated performance data into strategic recommendations for multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail verticals (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Built scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction across the partner base.
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value to their own customers.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to route structured, high-priority customer feedback into the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.
Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between teams.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Drove team initiatives for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training, and developing sales training for tenured account executives.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for all but the final months of tenure, sustained while quota roughly doubled.
Sold and scoped CRM and project-management software to agencies and professional-services firms, advising C-suite stakeholders as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Advised clients on CRM adoption and built scalable operational systems aligned to their growth stage and team structure.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
